name: quality-principles-suite
description: Meta-bundle: the code-quality disciplines that advise rather than enforce — approach deliberation and design patterns, OWASP security review and threat modeling, systematic debugging, measure-first performance, resilience with the merged error-handling and concurrency disciplines, dependency hygiene and stack inventory (stack-scan), observability, and test design and coverage review. Accessibility auditing lives in ui-ux (frontend-suite, craft-suite). Split out of quality-suite so a project can take the enforcing half without the advisory half's always-on context; the membership rule is prose, not script-checked. Uninstall cleanly with /quality-principles-suite:uninstall. 200k-window installs: see the README's context-window requirement first.
